Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: Sent every second for which at least one ITTO message is being generated. For bandwidth efficiency the timestamp is separated into this standalone Seconds message and a Nanoseconds portion carried by every other message.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Message.Name: Base Reference Message
Message.Description: Indicates the base reference number to which all the order, quote and trade reference number deltas must be added to obtain the absolute order or quote Nasdaq reference number. Sent prior to any order, quote and trade messages.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Base Reference Number
Field.Description: The base reference number.

Message.Name: Options Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates options symbol directory messages for all active options symbols in the Nasdaq option system. Intra-day updates are sent as they occur; for a given Option Id the canonical information is invariant.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol.

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1- 31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Call option Put option

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the Option, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique symbol assigned to the underlying security within exchange.

Field.Name: Options Closing Type
Field.Description: Denotes which System Event is used to trigger the option closing process.

Field.Name: Tradable
Field.Description: Denotes whether or not this option is tradable at the exchange. The allowable values are:

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: Minimum Price Variation for this option. See Notes below for further explanation:

Message.Name: Options Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of an index or equity option within the Nasdaq Options Market. Prior to the start of system hours Nasdaq sends a Trading Action spin carrying T (Trading Resumption) for every contract eligible for trading; an option absent from the spin should be treated as halted.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the options security in the Nasdaq Options Market. The allowable values are:

Message.Name: Option Open Message
Message.Description: Disseminated for each option as soon as the opening is completed. On the open state the option is available for auto execution within the Nasdaq Options Market System; on the closed state it is no longer eligible. Recipients should continue to process the Trading Action spin, which this message does not override.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: The allowable values are:

Message.Name: Add Order Message Short Form
Message.Description: Indicates that a new order has been accepted by the Nasdaq Option system and was added to the displayable book, carrying a day unique Order Reference Number. The short form of the message, published for bandwidth efficiency.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Order Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The unique reference number delta assigned to the new order. The order reference number is Increasing, but not necessarily sequential.

Field.Name: Market Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order being added to the book. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the new order being added to the book.

Message.Name: Add Order Message Long Form
Message.Description: Indicates that a new order has been accepted by the Nasdaq Option system and was added to the displayable book, carrying a day unique Order Reference Number. The long form of the message, with four byte price and volume.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Order Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The unique reference number delta assigned to the new order. The order reference number is Increasing, but not necessarily sequential.

Field.Name: Market Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the new order being added to the book.

Message.Name: Add Quote Message Short Form
Message.Description: Indicates that a new quote has been accepted by the Nasdaq Option system and was added to the displayable book, carrying unique Bid and Ask Reference Numbers. The short form of the message, published for bandwidth efficiency.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The bid reference number delta associated with the new quote.

Field.Name: Ask Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The ask reference number delta associated with the new quote

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The display bid price of the new quote. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: The bid contracts of the new quote.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The display ask price of the new quote. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: The ask contracts of the new quote.

Message.Name: Add Quote Message Long Form
Message.Description: Indicates that a new quote has been accepted by the Nasdaq Option system and was added to the displayable book, carrying unique Bid and Ask Reference Numbers. The long form of the message, with four byte prices and sizes.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The bid reference number delta associated with the new quote.

Field.Name: Ask Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The ask reference number delta associated with the new quote

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Bid
Field.Description: The display bid price of the new quote.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: The bid contracts of the new quote.

Field.Name: Ask
Field.Description: The display ask price of the new quote.

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: The ask contracts of the new quote.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever a Side order, an order or one side of a quote, is executed in whole or in part. Several of these messages may be received for the same Side order when it is executed in several parts, and they are cumulative.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Contracts
Field.Description: The number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an incoming Side order is executed against the book in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price, so the execution price is carried in the message.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The execution contracts.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order on the book is modified as a result of a partial cancellation.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Order Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Cancelled Contracts
Field.Description: The number of contracts to be removed from the display size of the order as the result of a cancellation.

Message.Name: Single Side Replace Message Short Form
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order or one side of a quote on the book is replaced. The replacement has a new sequence number and replaces the prior sequence number. The short form of the message, published for bandwidth efficiency.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Original Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original reference number delta associated with the order being replaced.

Field.Name: New Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The new reference number delta associated with the new order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the replaced order being added to the book. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the replaced order being added to the book.

Message.Name: Single Side Replace Message Long Form
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order or one side of a quote on the book is replaced. The replacement has a new sequence number and replaces the prior sequence number. The long form of the message, with four byte price and volume.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Original Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original reference number delta associated with the order being replaced.

Field.Name: New Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The new reference number delta associated with the new order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the replaced order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the replaced order being added to the book.

Message.Name: Single Side Delete Message
Message.Description: Sent when an order or a side of a quote is being cancelled. All remaining contracts are no longer accessible so the side should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the cancelled order.

Message.Name: Single Side Update Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an order or a side of a quote is being updated for price and or contracts. The reference number associated with the order or quote is unchanged and it retains its priority on the book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The reference number delta associated with the update for an order or quote.

Field.Name: Change Reason
Field.Description: `U' - USER `R' REPRICE `S' - SUSPEND

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the updated side order on the book.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the updated side order on the book.

Message.Name: Quote Replace Message Short Form
Message.Description: Sent whenever a quote on the book is replaced. The replaced quote has new sequence numbers on both sides, replacing the prior sequence numbers. The short form of the message, published for bandwidth efficiency.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Original Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original bid reference number delta that is replaced

Field.Name: Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The bid reference number delta associated with the replaced quote

Field.Name: Original Ask Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original ask reference number delta that is replaced

Field.Name: Ask Reference Delta Number
Field.Description: The ask reference number delta associated with the replaced quote

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The display bid price of the replaced quote. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: The display bid contracts of the replaced quote.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The display ask price of the replaced quote. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: The display ask contracts of the replaced quote.

Message.Name: Quote Replace Message Long Form
Message.Description: Sent whenever a quote on the book is replaced. The replaced quote has new sequence numbers on both sides, replacing the prior sequence numbers. The long form of the message, with four byte prices and sizes.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Original Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original bid reference number delta that is replaced

Field.Name: Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The bid reference number delta associated with the replaced quote

Field.Name: Original Ask Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The original ask reference number delta that is replaced

Field.Name: Ask Reference Delta Number
Field.Description: The ask reference number delta associated with the replaced quote

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: The display bid price of the replaced quote.

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: The display bid contracts of the replaced quote.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: The display ask price of the replaced quote.

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: The display ask contracts of the replaced quote.

Message.Name: Quote Delete Message
Message.Description: Sent when a single quote is being cancelled. All remaining contracts are no longer accessible so the quote should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Bid Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The bid reference number delta associated with the delete

Field.Name: Ask Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The ask reference number delta associated with the delete

Message.Name: Block Single Side Delete Message
Message.Description: Contains a block of Single Side Deletes. Each reference number inside the block represents an order or a side of a quote that is being cancelled; all remaining contracts are no longer accessible so the side should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Total Number of Reference Number Deltas.
Field.Description: The number of single side deletes in this block. Max possible value = 360

Field.Name: Reference Number Deltas
Field.Description: The block of single side deletes, one four byte reference number delta per entry at offset 4n + 7, repeated Total Number of Reference Number Deltas times.

Message.Name: Options Trade Non Auction Message
Message.Description: Provides execution details for normal match events involving non displayable order types, for which no Add Order or Add Quote message is generated. Auction events are reported separately by the Options Cross Trade message.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: The type of non-display order on the book being matched.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The execution contracts.

Message.Name: Options Cross Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent for every option when an auction in that option is completed, indicating the bulk volume associated with the auction event. Also used to report all executions within a price improvement (PRISM) auction. To avoid double counting of auction volume, firms should not include transactions marked as auction trades.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The Nasdaq auction session for which the message is being generated.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The cross price in the auction.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The contracts executed in the auction.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Or Order Execution Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever an execution on Nasdaq is broken, which may happen if it is found to be clearly erroneous pursuant to the Nasdaq Clearly Erroneous Policy. A trade break is final; once a trade is broken it cannot be reinstated.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Net Order Imbalance Indicator Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq disseminates Net Order Imbalance Indicator data at five second intervals in the minutes leading up to the Nasdaq Opening Auction events, and for price improvement (PRISM) auctions.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of Auction:

Field.Name: Paired Contracts
Field.Description: The total number of contracts that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price. 0 for Price Improvement (PRISM) Auction.

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: Indicates the market side of the imbalance

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Imbalance Price
Field.Description: The imbalance price. 0 for Price Improvement (PRISM) Auction

Field.Name: Imbalance Volume
Field.Description: The imbalance volume.

Field.Name: Customer/ Firm Indicator
Field.Description: For Order Exposure (AuctionType=I) only. Indicates the order capacity:

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Group.Name: Reference Number Deltas
Group.Dependency: Total Number of Reference Number Deltas.
Group.Description: The block of single side deletes, one four byte reference number delta per entry at offset 4n + 7, repeated Total Number of Reference Number Deltas times.

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order or quote side reference number delta associated with the cancelled order or quote, for n = 0 to the Total Number less one.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. This is always the first message sent in any trading day, typically after ~2:00am.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Start of System Hours. Indicates that Nasdaq is open and ready to start accepting orders, typically 7:00am.

Value.Name: Start of Opening Process
Value.Description: Start of Opening Process. Indicates that Nasdaq has started its opening auction process, typically 9:30:00am.

Value.Name: End of Normal Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Normal Hours Processing. Indicates that Nasdaq will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during normal trading hours, typically 4:00:00pm.

Value.Name: End of Late Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Late Hours Processing. Indicates that Nasdaq will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during extended hours, typically 4:15:00pm.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. Indicates that the Nasdaq options system is now closed, typically ~5:15pm.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day, typically ~5:20pm.

Value.Name: Option is not tradable
Value.Description: Option is not tradable. Sent intra-day when an option is removed from the system; quotes sent for it will be rejected and existing quotes purged.

Value.Name: Penny Everywhere
Value.Description: All prices are in penny increments

Value.Name: Scaled
Value.Description: Prices below $3.00 are in increments of $0.05, prices above $3.00 are in increments of $0.10

Value.Name: Penny Pilot
Value.Description: Prices below $3.00 are in increments of $0.01, prices above $3.00 are in increments of $0.05

Value.Name: Buy Side Trading Suspended
Value.Description: Buy Side Trading Suspended, that is buy orders are not executable

Value.Name: Sell Side Trading Suspended
Value.Description: Sell Side Trading Suspended, that is sell orders are not executable

Value.Name: Non Printable
Value.Description: The execution should not be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations

Value.Name: Printable
Value.Description: The execution should be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations

Value.Name: Buy Order
Value.Description: The non display order on the book being matched is a buy order

Value.Name: Sell Order
Value.Description: The non display order on the book being matched is a sell order

Value.Name: Broker Dealer
Value.Description: Broker Dealer or Non Registered Market Maker
